sources.title: fal H3 Max post-trained video model (throughput, rankings, pricing)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: fal released H3 Max on 2026-09-01, developed by fal Research by post-training the open-weights MiniMax H3 model with additional data and an in-house reinforcement learning framework focused on prompt adherence and visual quality, co-designed with a dedicated inference engine; a five-second video in approximately three seconds of wall time, roughly 35x the throughput of the official MiniMax H3 endpoint and on average 15x faster than comparable-quality models in fal testing.
claims.context: Vendor-via-PR release (PR Newswire, source fal, Sep 01 2026 11:10 ET); speed and training claims are fal assertions including fal-run testing.

claims.text: Design Arena ranks H3 Max #1 on its recent Image-to-Video leaderboard with Elo 1341, ahead of official MiniMax H3 at 1333 plus Seedance 2.5 and Gemini Omni Flash, reflecting publicly available results as of August 26, 2026; rankings may change as models and evaluations are added.
claims.context: Vendor-cited independent leaderboard bound to August 26, 2026 per benchmark methodology note; not live-rechecked from this source.

claims.text: Artificial Analysis ranks fal H3 #1 on its Image-to-Video Leaderboard with Audio with Elo 1201 across 2177 samples, ahead of Seedance 2.0, MiniMax H3, Gemini Omni Flash, Veo 3.1, and Kling 3.0, reflecting publicly available results as of August 26, 2026.
claims.context: Vendor-cited independent leaderboard bound to August 26, 2026 per methodology note; sample count and ordering as reported by fal.

claims.text: H3 Max is available via fal API, Playground, and fal Agent for text-to-video and image-to-video at 768p promotional pricing of $0.04 per second for the first week ending September 7, reverting to $0.08 per second thereafter.
claims.context: Vendor-via-PR availability and time-bound pricing; offered as stated in the release Availability and Pricing sections.

limitations.text: Authority is vendor-via-PR, not first-party docs or independently fetched leaderboards.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Independent rankings are date-bound to August 26, 2026 and may have changed; fal internal head-to-head testing against 12 models not reproducible from this source.
